Apply via DM or email: #hiring #remotejobs #vexos #therenderpos #proptech #projectmanager #clientsuccess #remotework #Brazil #Mexico #latinamerica

title: Client services assistant
description:
Empresa está contratando Client services assistant em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Client Services Assistant Remote, Latin America Velocity Work helps law firm owners build firms that are profitable, organized, accountable, and not dependent on the owner holding everything together. We're hiring a Client Services Assistant to become a true backbone for our team. This is not a "wait for instructions" role. It's for someone who sees loose ends, tracks the moving pieces, asks smart questions, and makes the system better without needing someone to hover. You'll support current clients, client data, retreat prep, onboarding, internal systems, pipeline tracking, and podcast scheduling. The work is detailed, important, and very real. If you like being the person who knows where things stand, what's missing, and what needs to happen next, this may be a great fit. What You'll Own ----------- Client Services Operations This is the center of the role. You'll help keep current client work moving cleanly: data workflows, dashboards, retreat materials, onboarding, Hub Spot notes, scheduling details, internal reports, recordings, client folders, and recurring team systems. You'll also help catch what's slipping before it becomes a problem: missing data, unclear ownership, stalled tasks, unlogged client context, messy files, late follow-ups, or anything that makes Client Services feel less prepared. The goal is simple: current clients feel cared for, Client Services feels supported, and the team trusts that the operational details are handled. Pipeline + Relationship Tracking You'll help us track important non-client relationships: incoming leads, meetings, deals, contracts, key dates, next steps, and handoffs. You won't be the salesperson or the primary external email owner. You'll keep the system accurate so the right person can follow through well and Client Services can provide a high-touch experience before someone becomes a client. Podcast Scheduling + Production Coordination You'll help keep our podcast schedule realistic and ahead of the calendar. That means protecting planning time, suggesting recording days that match the production schedule, tracking key dates, and flagging when we need to record multiple episodes ahead because the business calendar is getting full. You won't own content, writing, editing, or creative direction. This is schedule, process, and timeline management. This Role Is a Fit If You: • Notice gaps and communicate them early • Take ownership without needing to be chased • Track details carefully and follow through completely • Ask smart questions, then remember the answer • Can support a busy team without adding noise • Stay calm when priorities shift • Take pride in being reliable, thorough, and useful This Role Is Not a Fit If You: • Need detailed instructions for every task • Wait to be told what to do next • See problems but don't speak up • Think "done" means "mostly handled" • Struggle when a process is not perfectly documented Requirements • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills • Clear written and verbal English • High ownership and follow-through • Strong attention to detail • Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities • Experience with calendars, spreadsheets, CRMs, project management tools, and modern Saa S systems • Fast, stable internet connection • Professional presence on video Tools may include Click Up, Hub Spot, Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, Loom, Fireflies, reporting dashboards, spreadsheets, and podcast scheduling tools. Work Setup Remote, Latin America preferred Contractor, 40 hours/week with meaningful overlap with U. S. business hours Compensation: $1000/mo USD (you will invoce your hours) How to Apply We care about experience, but we care more about ownership, judgment, communication, and follow-through. You'll submit: • Your resume • A short video introducing yourself and telling us why this role speaks to you • Anything else that helps us understand how you think and work We will follow up with a shortlist of prospects and request a Sample Project submission that will demonstrate aspects of the work you'll be doing, and we will compensate you for the time that takes. We're looking for someone who wants to become a real operational partner to the team, not just complete assigned tasks. If you're the kind of person who sees the gap, owns the follow-through, and makes the whole team feel more organized, we want to meet you.

title: Global ta manager (contractor role)
description:
Empresa está contratando Global ta manager (contractor role) em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Location: Remote (Based in Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, or Brazil) Contract Duration: 6 months (with potential for extension/long-term partnership) Compensation: Base Rate + Performance-Based Placement Bonus (Earn extra for every successful hire!) Role Overview We are stripping away the corporate red tape. This role is built for one thing and one thing only: Pure, High-Velocity Recruitment Delivery. As a Global TA Manager, you will focus entirely on the frontlines of our international experienced hiring tracks (spanning R& D, Product, and Growth) across the U. S., Europe, LATAM, and Asia. You will be the bridging force between global talent and our HQ team. If you are an independent recruiter who prides yourself on speed, market-mapping accuracy, and closing deals, this is your playground. What You Will Do- High-Volume Sourcing & Delivery: Own the end-to-end sourcing and pipeline management for mid-to-senior global roles. You will hunt via Linked In, regional job boards, Git Hub, and cold-outreach to keep our pipelines buzzing. HQ & Candidate Facilitation: Screen global talent, pitch our vision, and seamlessly manage candidates through the interview process, acting as the primary point of contact. Data & Pipeline Transparency: Keep candidate trackers clean and updated, ensuring our global talent pipelines are accurate and moving fast. The DNA We Are Looking For- The Baseline (Hard Skills): Bilingual Mastery (English & Chinese): Both English and Mandarin Chinese must be your fluent working languages. You can interview global talent in flawless English and align instantly with our HQ hiring managers in Chinese. Proven Recruitment Engine: 2-4+ years of recruiting experience in tech, internet, or global expansion enterprises. A proven track record of delivering cross-border talent is a massive plus. Geographic Flexibility: Based in Indonesia, Vietnam, or the U. S., with deep roots in local talent networks but a completely global mindset. Core Traits (Soft Skills): The \"Bias for Action\" Delivery Machine: You are fiercely result-oriented, self-driven, and hyper-focused on closing roles. You think on your feet and get things done without waiting for instructions. Insatiable Curiosity & No Guardrails: You don't get trapped by fixed processes. You are eager to experiment with new sourcing hacks, leverage AI tools, and test bold outreach strategies to find that needle in a haystack. What You Will Get & The Challenges You Will Face What You Will Get: Uncapped Earning Potential: On top of your base rate, we offer a highly competitive, milestone-based placement bonus layout. The faster and more effectively you deliver, the more you earn. The Global Flex-Work Playbook: Get hands-on, practical experience inside a highly progressive global flexible-staffing ecosystem. You'll see exactly how a top-tier global tech brand runs an agile, remote talent network. A Trusted Extension of the Crew: No micromanagement. You enjoy the ultimate flexibility of a remote setup while having a world-class global TA team supporting you from behind. The Challenges You Will Face: 100% Remote Coordination: Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule. Embracing Ambiguity: Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts. If you are a bilingual recruitment hustler who is ready to deliver global talent and write your own paycheck via performance bonuses, let's talk. Apply now and let's make a global impact together!

title: Video editor
description:
Empresa está contratando Video editor em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Beige is looking for an exceptional, high-energy Video Editor to join our production powerhouse, transform raw footage into visual masterpieces, and elevate our digital storytelling capabilities. This is not a traditional, slow-paced editing role. You will operate as a critical driver of our creative output, taking extreme ownership of asset management, motion graphics, and premium post-production workflows for a rapidly growing media technology startup. If you're someone who thrives in high-performance environments, possesses cutting-edge technical skills, and is obsessed with visual precision and pacing, we want to hear from you. About Beige Beige is an AI-powered media technology platform transforming how content is booked, produced, managed, and delivered at scale. Through Beige.app, businesses, brands, creators, events, families, and enterprises can seamlessly access content production, media services, creative talent, and technology-driven workflows through a modern, intelligent platform. We have facilitated thousands of productions and work with startups, major brands, Fortune 500 companies, athletes, creators, celebrities, and high-profile individuals across the United States and internationally. We're building much more than a service company — we're building infrastructure for the future of content. As Beige scales aggressively, we're building a team obsessed with speed, ownership, execution, innovation, and growth. Location & Schedule Location: Remote (International / Global Talent) Schedule: Must be fully available to operate and collaborate during the following US Central Standard Time (CST) hours: Monday - Friday: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM CST Compensation Contract Rate: Starting at $400/month What You'll Be Doing Asset & Footage Management: Efficiently download, structure, and organize massive batches of raw multimedia assets for seamless editing workflows. Premium Video Editing: Edit high-quality video content that directly meets and exceeds strict project brief requirements and client expectations. Advanced Post-Production: Apply advanced editing techniques, including smooth transitions, continuous pacing, text overlays, and audio syncing. Motion Graphics & Animation: Integrate clean motion graphics and 2 D animation to drive engagement and elevate production value. Color & Audio Enhancement: Execute professional color correction, grading, and sound mixing to ensure visually stunning and acoustically crisp final deliverables. Pipeline Speed: Ruthlessly hit tight production deadlines while keeping asset quality, creativity, and rendering optimization locked in. Who We're Looking For Required Qualifications: Strong English Proficiency: High fluency in written and spoken English with exceptional team communication skills. Proven Experience: Minimum of 2+ years of professional video editing and motion graphics experience within an agency, production house, or startup environment. Software Mastery: Expert-level mastery of Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects (or equivalent industry-standard professional editing tools). Technical Hardware Setup: A powerful, dedicated editing machine alongside highly reliable high-speed internet and stable power backup/electricity. Creative Portfolio: A comprehensive, high-quality showreel or portfolio demonstrating your editing pace, design style, and technical versatility. Preferred / Major Plus: Deep experience editing content specifically tailored for the creator economy, social media platforms (Tik Tok, Reels, You Tube), or premium corporate brand campaigns. Advanced proficiency using AI generation and automation tools to accelerate asset workflows. Familiarity with modern remote productivity and tracking tools (Google Workspace, Slack, Asana, Notion). Core Behavioral Expectations: To succeed in this role, you must be obsessed with visual detail and speed. You need to welcome rapidly shifting creative priorities, accept constructive feedback with professionalism, and actively prefer executing high-impact digital storytelling over low-stakes, formulaic editing routines.

description:

Client Services Assistant Remote, Latin America Velocity Work helps law firm owners build firms that are profitable, organized, accountable, and not dependent on the owner holding everything together. We're hiring a Client Services Assistant to become a true backbone for our team. This is not a "wait for instructions" role. It's for someone who sees loose ends, tracks the moving pieces, asks smart questions, and makes the system better without needing someone to hover. You'll support current clients, client data, retreat prep, onboarding, internal systems, pipeline tracking, and podcast scheduling. The work is detailed, important, and very real. If you like being the person who knows where things stand, what's missing, and what needs to happen next, this may be a great fit. What You'll Own ----------- Client Services Operations This is the center of the role. You'll help keep current client work moving cleanly: data workflows, dashboards, retreat materials, onboarding, Hub Spot notes, scheduling details, internal reports, recordings, client folders, and recurring team systems. You'll also help catch what's slipping before it becomes a problem: missing data, unclear ownership, stalled tasks, unlogged client context, messy files, late follow-ups, or anything that makes Client Services feel less prepared. The goal is simple: current clients feel cared for, Client Services feels supported, and the team trusts that the operational details are handled. Pipeline + Relationship Tracking You'll help us track important non-client relationships: incoming leads, meetings, deals, contracts, key dates, next steps, and handoffs. You won't be the salesperson or the primary external email owner. You'll keep the system accurate so the right person can follow through well and Client Services can provide a high-touch experience before someone becomes a client. Podcast Scheduling + Production Coordination You'll help keep our podcast schedule realistic and ahead of the calendar. That means protecting planning time, suggesting recording days that match the production schedule, tracking key dates, and flagging when we need to record multiple episodes ahead because the business calendar is getting full. You won't own content, writing, editing, or creative direction. This is schedule, process, and timeline management. This Role Is a Fit If You: • Notice gaps and communicate them early • Take ownership without needing to be chased • Track details carefully and follow through completely • Ask smart questions, then remember the answer • Can support a busy team without adding noise • Stay calm when priorities shift • Take pride in being reliable, thorough, and useful This Role Is Not a Fit If You: • Need detailed instructions for every task • Wait to be told what to do next • See problems but don't speak up • Think "done" means "mostly handled" • Struggle when a process is not perfectly documented Requirements • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills • Clear written and verbal English • High ownership and follow-through • Strong attention to detail • Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities • Experience with calendars, spreadsheets, CRMs, project management tools, and modern Saa S systems • Fast, stable internet connection • Professional presence on video Tools may include Click Up, Hub Spot, Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, Loom, Fireflies, reporting dashboards, spreadsheets, and podcast scheduling tools. Work Setup Remote, Latin America preferred Contractor, 40 hours/week with meaningful overlap with U. S. business hours Compensation: $1000/mo USD (you will invoce your hours) How to Apply We care about experience, but we care more about ownership, judgment, communication, and follow-through. You'll submit: • Your resume • A short video introducing yourself and telling us why this role speaks to you • Anything else that helps us understand how you think and work We will follow up with a shortlist of prospects and request a Sample Project submission that will demonstrate aspects of the work you'll be doing, and we will compensate you for the time that takes. We're looking for someone who wants to become a real operational partner to the team, not just complete assigned tasks. If you're the kind of person who sees the gap, owns the follow-through, and makes the whole team feel more organized, we want to meet you.

title: Senior java developer
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior java developer em manaus. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

A VMetrix é uma plataforma Saa S que atende instituições financeiras na América Latina. Processamos fluxos transacionais complexos, pipelines de dados de alto volume e integrações em tempo real — tudo construído sobre uma stack Java/Spring Boot + Oracle implantada na Oracle Cloud. Buscamos desenvolvedores Java sólidos que escrevam código excelente, pensem em sistemas e adotem o desenvolvimento assistido por IA como parte central do seu fluxo de trabalho. Propósito do Cargo Como Senior Java Developer, você vai construir e manter serviços backend e módulos de plataforma que suportam operações críticas de negócio. Você não precisa de experiência prévia no domínio financeiro — nós ensinamos. O que precisamos é de um desenvolvedor que escreva Java limpo e performante, domine padrões de design, entenda sistemas distribuídos e use ferramentas como Claude Code para se mover rápido sem sacrificar qualidade. Responsabilidades Principais: Desenvolvimento Backend Projetar, construir e manter serviços backend em Java 8+/Spring Boot: APIs REST, jobs de processamento batch, pipelines de transformação de dados e camadas de integração. Escrever código limpo, bem testado e pronto para produção, aplicando princípios SOLID, padrões de design (Strategy, Factory, Observer, Builder, Template Method, entre outros) e as diretrizes arquiteturais da equipe. Ser dono de features end-to-end: desde o design técnico até a implementação, testes, code review e deploy em produção. Otimizar o desempenho de aplicações: identificar e resolver gargalos em queries, chamadas a serviços, uso de memória e throughput. Aplicar corretamente padrões de concorrência e gerenciamento de threads em Java para operações paralelas e assíncronas. Design e Arquitetura Participar de decisões de design de software: seleção de padrões, definição de contratos entre componentes, separação de responsabilidades e modelagem de domínios. Aplicar princípios de design orientado a objetos (encapsulamento, herança, composição, polimorfismo) e design por contrato na construção de módulos. Contribuir para o design de arquiteturas limpas: separação de camadas (controller, service, repository), injeção de dependências, inversão de controle e baixo acoplamento entre módulos. Avaliar trade-offs técnicos entre diferentes abordagens de design, documentando decisões e suas justificativas. Banco de Dados e Integrações Trabalhar com Oracle Database: escrever e otimizar consultas SQL, stored procedures e packages PL/SQL para operações intensivas em dados. Construir e manter integrações com sistemas externos via APIs REST, cobrindo ingestão, transformação e sincronização de dados. Projetar padrões de acesso a dados eficientes usando JPA/Hibernate ou JDBC, com atenção a gerenciamento de conexões, cache de entidades e limites transacionais. Implementar estratégias de resiliência em integrações: retentativas, circuit breakers, timeouts e tratamento gracioso de falhas. Infraestrutura e Deploy Implantar e gerenciar aplicações em Kubernetes (OKE) com contêineres Docker e servidor de aplicações Web Logic. Trabalhar com pipelines CI/CD (Git Lab CI ou similar) para fluxos automatizados de build, teste e deployment. Diagnosticar problemas em produção: analisar logs, métricas de aplicação e comportamento do sistema para resolver incidentes. Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA Usar Claude Code como ferramenta principal de desenvolvimento: geração de código, refatoração, debugging, escrita de testes e exploração de codebases desconhecidos. Escrever e manter documentação técnica em Markdown que sirva como contexto de alta qualidade tanto para ferramentas de IA quanto para a equipe. Aplicar habilidades de engenharia de prompts: decompor problemas complexos em prompts claros e acionáveis, avaliando criticamente as saídas geradas por IA. Contribuir para as práticas de desenvolvimento com IA da equipe: compartilhar padrões eficazes, identificar limitações e ajudar a estabelecer melhores práticas. Colaboração e Crescimento Participar de revisões de código com feedback construtivo e rigoroso, focado em corretude, legibilidade, padrões e manutenibilidade. Mentorar desenvolvedores junior através de pair programming, discussões de design e transferência de conhecimento. Contribuir para discussões técnicas sobre arquitetura, ferramentas e melhorias de processos. Requisitos Obrigatórios: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas. 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento Java. Domínio sólido de Java 8+ (streams, lambdas, concorrência, collections, Optional, API de data/hora) e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, segurança, Spring Data, testes). Conhecimento sólido de padrões de design Go F (criacionais, estruturais, comportamentais) e capacidade de aplicá-los corretamente conforme o contexto do problema. Domínio dos princípios SOLID, DRY, KISS e YAGNI na prática diária de desenvolvimento. Experiência com design orientado a objetos: modelagem de domínios, composição vs herança, encapsulamento, tratamento de exceções e design de APIs internas claras. Habilidades sólidas em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais: otimização de queries, estratégias de indexação, joins complexos, gerenciamento transacional. Experiência com Oracle é um diferencial forte. Experiência com estratégias de testes: testes unitários (JUnit, Mockito), testes de integração, test doubles e TDD ou BDD como prática habitual. Experiência com deploys em contêineres: Docker, Kubernetes (qualquer distribuição), pipelines CI/CD. Familiaridade com fluxos Git (Git Flow ou trunk-based), Postman/Open API para desenvolvimento de APIs. Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA — especialmente Claude Code. Esperamos que você use IA diariamente como multiplicador de produtividade, não como muleta. Comunicação escrita sólida: capacidade de produzir specs técnicos claros, documentos de design e descrições de PR. Requisitos Desejáveis: Experiência com Oracle PL/SQL: stored procedures, pipelined functions, performance tuning. Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura: caching (Caffeine/Redis), arquitetura event-driven, design metadata-driven, CQRS. Experiência com arquiteturas de microsserviços ou modular monolith: estratégias de comunicação entre serviços, gerenciamento de transações distribuídas, contract testing. Familiaridade com Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture ou Domain-Driven Design (DDD). Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade: Grafana, Prometheus, métricas de aplicação, agregação de logs. Familiaridade com servidor de aplicações Web Logic ou runtimes Java empresariais similares. Experiência trabalhando em plataformas Saa S ou sistemas multi-tenant. Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações técnicas equivalentes. O Que Valorizamos: Qualidade acima de velocidade: preferimos entregar código limpo e bem testado um dia depois do que debugar um desastre por uma semana. Fluência com IA: você vê Claude Code e ferramentas similares como partes essenciais do seu toolkit, não como novidades. Sabe quando confiar no output e quando questioná-lo. Critério de design: você não aplica padrões por inércia — sabe quando um Strategy simplifica e quando um if-else é suficiente. Prioriza clareza acima de cleverness. Pensamento sistêmico: considera os efeitos downstream das suas decisões de design em desempenho, manutenibilidade e velocidade da equipe. Ownership: leva suas features do design até produção e se importa com como seu código se comporta no mundo real. Curiosidade: se mantém atualizado com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento, e tem interesse genuíno em evoluir no seu ofício. Comunicação clara: escreve documentação que seus colegas de equipe (e as ferramentas de IA) realmente conseguem usar. Processo de Candidatura: Candidatura: Candidate-se diretamente pelo Linked In. Teste técnico: Os candidatos selecionados receberão uma avaliação técnica online. Esta etapa é obrigatória e parte fundamental do processo. Entrevista com Líder e RH: Uma conversa com a equipe para te conhecer melhor e aprofundar sua experiência. Decisão: Informaremos o resultado com feedback, independentemente de você avançar ou não. Por que trabalhar na VMetrix Na VMetrix, não buscamos "fazer mais barulho", mas sim construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva. Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional. Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relações de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, a VMetrix é o lugar.

title: Direct-response ad video editor
description:
Nova oportunidade para Direct-response ad video editor em rio branco. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

We're looking for a direct response video editor who can produce 1-3 performance ads per day — consistently, quickly, and without hand-holding. You'll receive reference ads, raw footage, AI-generated visuals, voiceover audio, product photography, UGC clips, and creative briefs. Your job is to turn those inputs into scroll-stopping Meta ads that look native to the feed, follow direct response principles, and are ready to launch same-day. Some days you'll get a detailed brief with every asset handed to you. Other days you'll get a reference ad and a direction — and you'll need to reverse-engineer the structure, build a visual concept, and deliver a finished ad using your own creative instincts. This is not a 9-to-5 editing job. This is a performance marketing role that happens to live inside an editing timeline. What You'll Be Doing Editing 1-3 short-form video ads per day (15-60 seconds) for Meta placements Working with a mix of UGC footage, AI-generated imagery, 3 D medical-style animations, product photography, voiceover tracks, and b-roll Receiving reference ads and reverse-engineering their pacing, structure, visual rhythm, and caption systems to build Velor Health versions Building ads from creative briefs that include scripts, shot lists, visual direction, and caption specs Originating new ad concepts when given only a direction or angle — proposing visual treatments, caption styles, and pacing without being told exactly what to do Implementing caption systems with color-coded text (white/red/blue pill captions, green keyword highlights, auto-generated Tik Tok-style captions) depending on the ad format Cutting multiple versions of the same ad (hook variants, length variants, aspect ratio variants) for A/B testing Maintaining a fast turnaround — most ads should go from brief to finished export within 2-4 hours Organizing and managing a growing library of raw assets, finished ads, and creative templates What You Need Proven experience editing direct response or performance marketing video ads (not brand content, not music videos, not wedding films — direct response ads that ran on Meta or Tik Tok with measurable results) Fluency in Cap Cut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects — whichever you're fastest in Strong understanding of Meta ad formats — you know what a native feed ad looks like versus a produced commercial, and you default to native Ability to match reference ad pacing intuitively — if we send you a competitor ad, you can deconstruct its cut timing, caption rhythm, and visual structure without being taught Comfort working with AI-generated imagery and integrating it seamlessly into live footage and product photography Experience with caption styling — you've built caption systems before (color-coded, keyword-highlighted, timed to VO) and you understand that captions are a conversion tool, not an accessibility afterthought A sharp eye for thumbnail-level scroll-stopping — you understand that the first frame of a video ad is a static image in the feed and you treat it accordingly Ability to self-manage, meet daily output targets, and communicate proactively when something is unclear or delayed Reliable internet connection and availability during US business hours (ET or CT preferred but flexible for the right person) Bonus (Not Required) Experience editing ads in the health, wellness, fitness, or DTC supplement space Familiarity with the \"ugly ad\" aesthetic — ads intentionally designed to look like organic UGC rather than polished production Experience with motion graphics or basic After Effects animation (for text overlays, simple transitions, or kinetic typography) Understanding of direct response copywriting principles (you know why a hook matters, why the product should appear early, why the CTA needs to sound like a peer recommendation) What You Don't Need A film degree A fancy reel of cinematic work Experience at a big agency Color grading expertise We care about speed, instinct, and output quality at volume. If your best work is a single beautifully-graded 3-minute brand film, this isn't the right fit. If your best work is 47 Meta ads you cut last month that all drove profitable ROAS, we want to talk to you. Compensation Competitive rate based on experience. This is a contract role with potential to grow into a long-term position as the brand scales. We value speed and consistency — editors who hit daily output targets reliably will have no shortage of work. How To Apply There will be a paid test before any hire is made. Here's how it works: Apply with your portfolio. Send 3-5 examples of direct response video ads you've edited that actually ran on Meta or Tik Tok. Tell us the niche, the objective, and the result if you have it. We don't need a sizzle reel — we need proof you've done this before. If your portfolio fits, we'll send you a paid test project. You'll receive a reference ad, a script, raw assets (footage, images, voiceover), and a creative brief. You'll have 24 hours to deliver a finished ad. This test is paid regardless of whether you're hired. We evaluate the test on four criteria: Did you match the pacing and structure of the reference? Did the first frame stop the scroll? Did the captions and visual rhythm support the VO? Did you deliver on time? If the test passes, you start with a one-week trial at 1 ad per day. If that week goes well, we scale to full output. We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for someone who ships fast, learns from references quickly, and gets better with every ad they cut. To apply, send your portfolio and a brief note about your direct response editing experience to (your email) with the subject line \"DR Editor — (Your Name).\"

title: Applied ai engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Applied ai engineer em palmas. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Applied AI Engineer Who We AreEnlightened Today is a rapidly expanding and innovative company leading the charge in the spiritual and wellness space. We are dedicated to changing the industry with bold, creative marketing strategies and forward-thinking technical solutions. Our team thrives on collaboration, innovation, and crafting content that deeply resonates with our audience. Our business model centers on creating authentic connections with our audience through digital channels and delivering premium services and products that meet their needs. The role This is a hands-on, embedded engineering role. Instead of sitting behind a backlog and building to spec, you'll embed directly with the founders and the team, figure out what the business actually needs (which is often not what was first asked for), and ship working AI solutions fast. You'll move fluidly between building AI agents, shipping customer-facing AI products, and wiring up the data that feeds both, talking to the people who'll use what you build, iterating in front of them, and turning rough ideas into things that work. In short: part engineer, part solutions architect, part builder-who-talks-to-humans. You'll be deployed against our own business and customers rather than external clients, but the instincts are the same: high autonomy, fast prototyping, strong communication, and a bias toward shipping something useful over perfecting something slowly. This is a \"hire for talent\" role, and we care far more about what you can build and how you think than about your years of experience or pedigree. If you're early-career but exceptional, or senior and want to get your hands dirty again, both are welcome. What you'll build You'll lead or contribute to three flagship initiatives: Agentic orchestration. We run our development and operations on an internal system of specialized AI agents, built on Claude Code, that plan, build, and review each other's work before anything ships, with reusable skills and adversarial review gates that keep quality high. You'll operate it, extend it, build new agents and skills for our specific workflows, and keep those quality gates sharp. Conversational AI grounded in the customer. Build AI chat and voice experiences that tap into a customer's profile and behavioral signals to have genuinely helpful, personalized conversations with them about their relationship and life questions, the core of what our customers come to us for. This spans retrieval over customer profiles, conversation memory, and (on the roadmap) real-time voice. Signal-based personalized marketing. Turn customer signals into tailored marketing: segments, scoring, and personalized messaging pushed through our marketing stack. This extends our existing lead-intelligence pipeline. You won't do all three every week, but over a quarter you'll likely touch all of them. Our stack AI / LLM: Claude (API + Claude Code), multi-agent orchestration, prompt and skill authoring, Eleven Labs for voice Primary language: Python Backend / data: Postgres / Supabase (incl. pgvector), REST APIs Frontend: Next.js, React, Vercel, HTML/CSS Marketing infra: Klaviyo, Checkout Champ, Hyros, attribution and CRM tools Tooling: Git/Git Hub, CI, modern AI-assisted dev workflows (some of our agent tooling touches shell + Type Script/Node) You don't need every item on this list. You do need to be the kind of person who picks up a new tool quickly and ships with it. What we're looking for Hands-on, embedded instincts: you can sit with a non-technical stakeholder, diagnose what they actually need, and turn it into something working, fast, and without a detailed spec Strong communication: you'll work directly with the founders and explain your work to non-engineers clearly Strong Python and solid full-stack fundamentals, comfortable across backend logic, data, and a functional frontend Real, hands-on LLM experience: prompting, retrieval (RAG), chaining, evaluating outputs, and handling the messy reality of non-deterministic systems Agentic experience: you've built or seriously operated multi-agent systems and understand orchestration, tool/function calling, and review/eval loops Fluency with AI-assisted development: you use tools like Claude Code daily and know how to get great output from them Solid engineering discipline: testing (we value TDD), clean Git workflows, and the judgment to build quality gates rather than skip them Comfortable in shell and Type Script/Node when the tooling calls for it, and you don't have to be an expert, but you can't be allergic to it A bias toward shipping: working software over perfect software Sound judgment around sensitive, emotional conversations. Our customers come to us about love and relationships; AI that talks with them needs guardrails, scope limits, escalation paths, and clear boundaries built in. We treat this as a design requirement, not an afterthought Care with personal data: customer profiles and conversation content are sensitive (consent, data minimization, secure storage, CCPA) Nice to have Prior solutions-engineering, founder, or consulting experience, or anything that put you face-to-face with the people you build for Experience with conversational/voice AI: TTS/STT, low-latency streaming, voice-agent frameworks (Live Kit, Pipecat, Vapi) Experience in DTC e-commerce, subscriptions, or performance marketing Familiarity with attribution/CRM platforms and marketing APIs Recommendation, personalization, or feature-store experience Familiarity with agentic frameworks (Lang Graph, Crew AI, Auto Gen, or similar) and the Agent Skills pattern A portfolio of shipped products, repos, demos, or AI projects we can look at Why this role is different Genuine ownership. Direct access to the founders, no layers of approval, and the ability to ship to real customers fast. You're close to the problem. You won't be handed tickets in isolation. You'll sit with the business, see the real need, and build for it directly. AI-native by default. You'll orchestrate AI agents rather than type every line, the way the best engineers will work in a few years. Breadth. If you're tired of being a cog on one narrow feature, this is the opposite. You'll touch the whole business. How to applyRecord a 3-minute video introducing yourself along with your resume to Tell us why you're excited about this role, and a few things we should know about you, professionally and personally.

title: Senior java developer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior java developer em palmas. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

A VMetrix é uma plataforma Saa S que atende instituições financeiras na América Latina. Processamos fluxos transacionais complexos, pipelines de dados de alto volume e integrações em tempo real — tudo construído sobre uma stack Java/Spring Boot + Oracle implantada na Oracle Cloud. Buscamos desenvolvedores Java sólidos que escrevam código excelente, pensem em sistemas e adotem o desenvolvimento assistido por IA como parte central do seu fluxo de trabalho. Propósito do Cargo Como Senior Java Developer, você vai construir e manter serviços backend e módulos de plataforma que suportam operações críticas de negócio. Você não precisa de experiência prévia no domínio financeiro — nós ensinamos. O que precisamos é de um desenvolvedor que escreva Java limpo e performante, domine padrões de design, entenda sistemas distribuídos e use ferramentas como Claude Code para se mover rápido sem sacrificar qualidade. Responsabilidades Principais: Desenvolvimento Backend Projetar, construir e manter serviços backend em Java 8+/Spring Boot: APIs REST, jobs de processamento batch, pipelines de transformação de dados e camadas de integração. Escrever código limpo, bem testado e pronto para produção, aplicando princípios SOLID, padrões de design (Strategy, Factory, Observer, Builder, Template Method, entre outros) e as diretrizes arquiteturais da equipe. Ser dono de features end-to-end: desde o design técnico até a implementação, testes, code review e deploy em produção. Otimizar o desempenho de aplicações: identificar e resolver gargalos em queries, chamadas a serviços, uso de memória e throughput. Aplicar corretamente padrões de concorrência e gerenciamento de threads em Java para operações paralelas e assíncronas. Design e Arquitetura Participar de decisões de design de software: seleção de padrões, definição de contratos entre componentes, separação de responsabilidades e modelagem de domínios. Aplicar princípios de design orientado a objetos (encapsulamento, herança, composição, polimorfismo) e design por contrato na construção de módulos. Contribuir para o design de arquiteturas limpas: separação de camadas (controller, service, repository), injeção de dependências, inversão de controle e baixo acoplamento entre módulos. Avaliar trade-offs técnicos entre diferentes abordagens de design, documentando decisões e suas justificativas. Banco de Dados e Integrações Trabalhar com Oracle Database: escrever e otimizar consultas SQL, stored procedures e packages PL/SQL para operações intensivas em dados. Construir e manter integrações com sistemas externos via APIs REST, cobrindo ingestão, transformação e sincronização de dados. Projetar padrões de acesso a dados eficientes usando JPA/Hibernate ou JDBC, com atenção a gerenciamento de conexões, cache de entidades e limites transacionais. Implementar estratégias de resiliência em integrações: retentativas, circuit breakers, timeouts e tratamento gracioso de falhas. Infraestrutura e Deploy Implantar e gerenciar aplicações em Kubernetes (OKE) com contêineres Docker e servidor de aplicações Web Logic. Trabalhar com pipelines CI/CD (Git Lab CI ou similar) para fluxos automatizados de build, teste e deployment. Diagnosticar problemas em produção: analisar logs, métricas de aplicação e comportamento do sistema para resolver incidentes. Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA Usar Claude Code como ferramenta principal de desenvolvimento: geração de código, refatoração, debugging, escrita de testes e exploração de codebases desconhecidos. Escrever e manter documentação técnica em Markdown que sirva como contexto de alta qualidade tanto para ferramentas de IA quanto para a equipe. Aplicar habilidades de engenharia de prompts: decompor problemas complexos em prompts claros e acionáveis, avaliando criticamente as saídas geradas por IA. Contribuir para as práticas de desenvolvimento com IA da equipe: compartilhar padrões eficazes, identificar limitações e ajudar a estabelecer melhores práticas. Colaboração e Crescimento Participar de revisões de código com feedback construtivo e rigoroso, focado em corretude, legibilidade, padrões e manutenibilidade. Mentorar desenvolvedores junior através de pair programming, discussões de design e transferência de conhecimento. Contribuir para discussões técnicas sobre arquitetura, ferramentas e melhorias de processos. Requisitos Obrigatórios: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas. 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento Java. Domínio sólido de Java 8+ (streams, lambdas, concorrência, collections, Optional, API de data/hora) e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, segurança, Spring Data, testes). Conhecimento sólido de padrões de design Go F (criacionais, estruturais, comportamentais) e capacidade de aplicá-los corretamente conforme o contexto do problema. Domínio dos princípios SOLID, DRY, KISS e YAGNI na prática diária de desenvolvimento. Experiência com design orientado a objetos: modelagem de domínios, composição vs herança, encapsulamento, tratamento de exceções e design de APIs internas claras. Habilidades sólidas em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais: otimização de queries, estratégias de indexação, joins complexos, gerenciamento transacional. Experiência com Oracle é um diferencial forte. Experiência com estratégias de testes: testes unitários (JUnit, Mockito), testes de integração, test doubles e TDD ou BDD como prática habitual. Experiência com deploys em contêineres: Docker, Kubernetes (qualquer distribuição), pipelines CI/CD. Familiaridade com fluxos Git (Git Flow ou trunk-based), Postman/Open API para desenvolvimento de APIs. Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA — especialmente Claude Code. Esperamos que você use IA diariamente como multiplicador de produtividade, não como muleta. Comunicação escrita sólida: capacidade de produzir specs técnicos claros, documentos de design e descrições de PR. Requisitos Desejáveis: Experiência com Oracle PL/SQL: stored procedures, pipelined functions, performance tuning. Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura: caching (Caffeine/Redis), arquitetura event-driven, design metadata-driven, CQRS. Experiência com arquiteturas de microsserviços ou modular monolith: estratégias de comunicação entre serviços, gerenciamento de transações distribuídas, contract testing. Familiaridade com Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture ou Domain-Driven Design (DDD). Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade: Grafana, Prometheus, métricas de aplicação, agregação de logs. Familiaridade com servidor de aplicações Web Logic ou runtimes Java empresariais similares. Experiência trabalhando em plataformas Saa S ou sistemas multi-tenant. Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações técnicas equivalentes. O Que Valorizamos: Qualidade acima de velocidade: preferimos entregar código limpo e bem testado um dia depois do que debugar um desastre por uma semana. Fluência com IA: você vê Claude Code e ferramentas similares como partes essenciais do seu toolkit, não como novidades. Sabe quando confiar no output e quando questioná-lo. Critério de design: você não aplica padrões por inércia — sabe quando um Strategy simplifica e quando um if-else é suficiente. Prioriza clareza acima de cleverness. Pensamento sistêmico: considera os efeitos downstream das suas decisões de design em desempenho, manutenibilidade e velocidade da equipe. Ownership: leva suas features do design até produção e se importa com como seu código se comporta no mundo real. Curiosidade: se mantém atualizado com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento, e tem interesse genuíno em evoluir no seu ofício. Comunicação clara: escreve documentação que seus colegas de equipe (e as ferramentas de IA) realmente conseguem usar. Processo de Candidatura: Candidatura: Candidate-se diretamente pelo Linked In. Teste técnico: Os candidatos selecionados receberão uma avaliação técnica online. Esta etapa é obrigatória e parte fundamental do processo. Entrevista com Líder e RH: Uma conversa com a equipe para te conhecer melhor e aprofundar sua experiência. Decisão: Informaremos o resultado com feedback, independentemente de você avançar ou não. Por que trabalhar na VMetrix Na VMetrix, não buscamos "fazer mais barulho", mas sim construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva. Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional. Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relações de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, a VMetrix é o lugar.

title: Applied ai engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Applied ai engineer em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Applied AI Engineer Who We AreEnlightened Today is a rapidly expanding and innovative company leading the charge in the spiritual and wellness space. We are dedicated to changing the industry with bold, creative marketing strategies and forward-thinking technical solutions. Our team thrives on collaboration, innovation, and crafting content that deeply resonates with our audience. Our business model centers on creating authentic connections with our audience through digital channels and delivering premium services and products that meet their needs. The role This is a hands-on, embedded engineering role. Instead of sitting behind a backlog and building to spec, you'll embed directly with the founders and the team, figure out what the business actually needs (which is often not what was first asked for), and ship working AI solutions fast. You'll move fluidly between building AI agents, shipping customer-facing AI products, and wiring up the data that feeds both, talking to the people who'll use what you build, iterating in front of them, and turning rough ideas into things that work. In short: part engineer, part solutions architect, part builder-who-talks-to-humans. You'll be deployed against our own business and customers rather than external clients, but the instincts are the same: high autonomy, fast prototyping, strong communication, and a bias toward shipping something useful over perfecting something slowly. This is a \"hire for talent\" role, and we care far more about what you can build and how you think than about your years of experience or pedigree. If you're early-career but exceptional, or senior and want to get your hands dirty again, both are welcome. What you'll build You'll lead or contribute to three flagship initiatives: Agentic orchestration. We run our development and operations on an internal system of specialized AI agents, built on Claude Code, that plan, build, and review each other's work before anything ships, with reusable skills and adversarial review gates that keep quality high. You'll operate it, extend it, build new agents and skills for our specific workflows, and keep those quality gates sharp. Conversational AI grounded in the customer. Build AI chat and voice experiences that tap into a customer's profile and behavioral signals to have genuinely helpful, personalized conversations with them about their relationship and life questions, the core of what our customers come to us for. This spans retrieval over customer profiles, conversation memory, and (on the roadmap) real-time voice. Signal-based personalized marketing. Turn customer signals into tailored marketing: segments, scoring, and personalized messaging pushed through our marketing stack. This extends our existing lead-intelligence pipeline. You won't do all three every week, but over a quarter you'll likely touch all of them. Our stack AI / LLM: Claude (API + Claude Code), multi-agent orchestration, prompt and skill authoring, Eleven Labs for voice Primary language: Python Backend / data: Postgres / Supabase (incl. pgvector), REST APIs Frontend: Next.js, React, Vercel, HTML/CSS Marketing infra: Klaviyo, Checkout Champ, Hyros, attribution and CRM tools Tooling: Git/Git Hub, CI, modern AI-assisted dev workflows (some of our agent tooling touches shell + Type Script/Node) You don't need every item on this list. You do need to be the kind of person who picks up a new tool quickly and ships with it. What we're looking for Hands-on, embedded instincts: you can sit with a non-technical stakeholder, diagnose what they actually need, and turn it into something working, fast, and without a detailed spec Strong communication: you'll work directly with the founders and explain your work to non-engineers clearly Strong Python and solid full-stack fundamentals, comfortable across backend logic, data, and a functional frontend Real, hands-on LLM experience: prompting, retrieval (RAG), chaining, evaluating outputs, and handling the messy reality of non-deterministic systems Agentic experience: you've built or seriously operated multi-agent systems and understand orchestration, tool/function calling, and review/eval loops Fluency with AI-assisted development: you use tools like Claude Code daily and know how to get great output from them Solid engineering discipline: testing (we value TDD), clean Git workflows, and the judgment to build quality gates rather than skip them Comfortable in shell and Type Script/Node when the tooling calls for it, and you don't have to be an expert, but you can't be allergic to it A bias toward shipping: working software over perfect software Sound judgment around sensitive, emotional conversations. Our customers come to us about love and relationships; AI that talks with them needs guardrails, scope limits, escalation paths, and clear boundaries built in. We treat this as a design requirement, not an afterthought Care with personal data: customer profiles and conversation content are sensitive (consent, data minimization, secure storage, CCPA) Nice to have Prior solutions-engineering, founder, or consulting experience, or anything that put you face-to-face with the people you build for Experience with conversational/voice AI: TTS/STT, low-latency streaming, voice-agent frameworks (Live Kit, Pipecat, Vapi) Experience in DTC e-commerce, subscriptions, or performance marketing Familiarity with attribution/CRM platforms and marketing APIs Recommendation, personalization, or feature-store experience Familiarity with agentic frameworks (Lang Graph, Crew AI, Auto Gen, or similar) and the Agent Skills pattern A portfolio of shipped products, repos, demos, or AI projects we can look at Why this role is different Genuine ownership. Direct access to the founders, no layers of approval, and the ability to ship to real customers fast. You're close to the problem. You won't be handed tickets in isolation. You'll sit with the business, see the real need, and build for it directly. AI-native by default. You'll orchestrate AI agents rather than type every line, the way the best engineers will work in a few years. Breadth. If you're tired of being a cog on one narrow feature, this is the opposite. You'll touch the whole business. How to applyRecord a 3-minute video introducing yourself along with your resume to Tell us why you're excited about this role, and a few things we should know about you, professionally and personally.

title: Client services assistant
description:
Nova oportunidade para Client services assistant em boa vista. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Client Services Assistant Remote, Latin America Velocity Work helps law firm owners build firms that are profitable, organized, accountable, and not dependent on the owner holding everything together. We're hiring a Client Services Assistant to become a true backbone for our team. This is not a "wait for instructions" role. It's for someone who sees loose ends, tracks the moving pieces, asks smart questions, and makes the system better without needing someone to hover. You'll support current clients, client data, retreat prep, onboarding, internal systems, pipeline tracking, and podcast scheduling. The work is detailed, important, and very real. If you like being the person who knows where things stand, what's missing, and what needs to happen next, this may be a great fit. What You'll Own ----------- Client Services Operations This is the center of the role. You'll help keep current client work moving cleanly: data workflows, dashboards, retreat materials, onboarding, Hub Spot notes, scheduling details, internal reports, recordings, client folders, and recurring team systems. You'll also help catch what's slipping before it becomes a problem: missing data, unclear ownership, stalled tasks, unlogged client context, messy files, late follow-ups, or anything that makes Client Services feel less prepared. The goal is simple: current clients feel cared for, Client Services feels supported, and the team trusts that the operational details are handled. Pipeline + Relationship Tracking You'll help us track important non-client relationships: incoming leads, meetings, deals, contracts, key dates, next steps, and handoffs. You won't be the salesperson or the primary external email owner. You'll keep the system accurate so the right person can follow through well and Client Services can provide a high-touch experience before someone becomes a client. Podcast Scheduling + Production Coordination You'll help keep our podcast schedule realistic and ahead of the calendar. That means protecting planning time, suggesting recording days that match the production schedule, tracking key dates, and flagging when we need to record multiple episodes ahead because the business calendar is getting full. You won't own content, writing, editing, or creative direction. This is schedule, process, and timeline management. This Role Is a Fit If You: • Notice gaps and communicate them early • Take ownership without needing to be chased • Track details carefully and follow through completely • Ask smart questions, then remember the answer • Can support a busy team without adding noise • Stay calm when priorities shift • Take pride in being reliable, thorough, and useful This Role Is Not a Fit If You: • Need detailed instructions for every task • Wait to be told what to do next • See problems but don't speak up • Think "done" means "mostly handled" • Struggle when a process is not perfectly documented Requirements • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills • Clear written and verbal English • High ownership and follow-through • Strong attention to detail • Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities • Experience with calendars, spreadsheets, CRMs, project management tools, and modern Saa S systems • Fast, stable internet connection • Professional presence on video Tools may include Click Up, Hub Spot, Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, Loom, Fireflies, reporting dashboards, spreadsheets, and podcast scheduling tools. Work Setup Remote, Latin America preferred Contractor, 40 hours/week with meaningful overlap with U. S. business hours Compensation: $1000/mo USD (you will invoce your hours) How to Apply We care about experience, but we care more about ownership, judgment, communication, and follow-through. You'll submit: • Your resume • A short video introducing yourself and telling us why this role speaks to you • Anything else that helps us understand how you think and work We will follow up with a shortlist of prospects and request a Sample Project submission that will demonstrate aspects of the work you'll be doing, and we will compensate you for the time that takes. We're looking for someone who wants to become a real operational partner to the team, not just complete assigned tasks. If you're the kind of person who sees the gap, owns the follow-through, and makes the whole team feel more organized, we want to meet you.

I am seeking an experienced Framer designer and developer to create a sophisticated personal website. This platform will serve to represent my work across three key areas: an organizational systems and operations consultant, a writer and content creator, and the founder of Ecohaus, a hospitality and land stewardship project based in Brazil. title: Direct-response ad video editor
description:
Empresa está contratando Direct-response ad video editor em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

We're looking for a direct response video editor who can produce 1-3 performance ads per day — consistently, quickly, and without hand-holding. You'll receive reference ads, raw footage, AI-generated visuals, voiceover audio, product photography, UGC clips, and creative briefs. Your job is to turn those inputs into scroll-stopping Meta ads that look native to the feed, follow direct response principles, and are ready to launch same-day. Some days you'll get a detailed brief with every asset handed to you. Other days you'll get a reference ad and a direction — and you'll need to reverse-engineer the structure, build a visual concept, and deliver a finished ad using your own creative instincts. This is not a 9-to-5 editing job. This is a performance marketing role that happens to live inside an editing timeline. What You'll Be Doing Editing 1-3 short-form video ads per day (15-60 seconds) for Meta placements Working with a mix of UGC footage, AI-generated imagery, 3 D medical-style animations, product photography, voiceover tracks, and b-roll Receiving reference ads and reverse-engineering their pacing, structure, visual rhythm, and caption systems to build Velor Health versions Building ads from creative briefs that include scripts, shot lists, visual direction, and caption specs Originating new ad concepts when given only a direction or angle — proposing visual treatments, caption styles, and pacing without being told exactly what to do Implementing caption systems with color-coded text (white/red/blue pill captions, green keyword highlights, auto-generated Tik Tok-style captions) depending on the ad format Cutting multiple versions of the same ad (hook variants, length variants, aspect ratio variants) for A/B testing Maintaining a fast turnaround — most ads should go from brief to finished export within 2-4 hours Organizing and managing a growing library of raw assets, finished ads, and creative templates What You Need Proven experience editing direct response or performance marketing video ads (not brand content, not music videos, not wedding films — direct response ads that ran on Meta or Tik Tok with measurable results) Fluency in Cap Cut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects — whichever you're fastest in Strong understanding of Meta ad formats — you know what a native feed ad looks like versus a produced commercial, and you default to native Ability to match reference ad pacing intuitively — if we send you a competitor ad, you can deconstruct its cut timing, caption rhythm, and visual structure without being taught Comfort working with AI-generated imagery and integrating it seamlessly into live footage and product photography Experience with caption styling — you've built caption systems before (color-coded, keyword-highlighted, timed to VO) and you understand that captions are a conversion tool, not an accessibility afterthought A sharp eye for thumbnail-level scroll-stopping — you understand that the first frame of a video ad is a static image in the feed and you treat it accordingly Ability to self-manage, meet daily output targets, and communicate proactively when something is unclear or delayed Reliable internet connection and availability during US business hours (ET or CT preferred but flexible for the right person) Bonus (Not Required) Experience editing ads in the health, wellness, fitness, or DTC supplement space Familiarity with the \"ugly ad\" aesthetic — ads intentionally designed to look like organic UGC rather than polished production Experience with motion graphics or basic After Effects animation (for text overlays, simple transitions, or kinetic typography) Understanding of direct response copywriting principles (you know why a hook matters, why the product should appear early, why the CTA needs to sound like a peer recommendation) What You Don't Need A film degree A fancy reel of cinematic work Experience at a big agency Color grading expertise We care about speed, instinct, and output quality at volume. If your best work is a single beautifully-graded 3-minute brand film, this isn't the right fit. If your best work is 47 Meta ads you cut last month that all drove profitable ROAS, we want to talk to you. Compensation Competitive rate based on experience. This is a contract role with potential to grow into a long-term position as the brand scales. We value speed and consistency — editors who hit daily output targets reliably will have no shortage of work. How To Apply There will be a paid test before any hire is made. Here's how it works: Apply with your portfolio. Send 3-5 examples of direct response video ads you've edited that actually ran on Meta or Tik Tok. Tell us the niche, the objective, and the result if you have it. We don't need a sizzle reel — we need proof you've done this before. If your portfolio fits, we'll send you a paid test project. You'll receive a reference ad, a script, raw assets (footage, images, voiceover), and a creative brief. You'll have 24 hours to deliver a finished ad. This test is paid regardless of whether you're hired. We evaluate the test on four criteria: Did you match the pacing and structure of the reference? Did the first frame stop the scroll? Did the captions and visual rhythm support the VO? Did you deliver on time? If the test passes, you start with a one-week trial at 1 ad per day. If that week goes well, we scale to full output. We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for someone who ships fast, learns from references quickly, and gets better with every ad they cut. To apply, send your portfolio and a brief note about your direct response editing experience to (your email) with the subject line \"DR Editor — (Your Name).\"
